Admission uses commit-reveal bound to a future randomness beacon. Each applicant posts a hash-commit from a worker thread, then reveals the preimage after the beacon emits unpredictable entropy.
A ridge filter scores deposit age, probe latency and origin entropy at reveal. Scores under 0.40 enter a 6-epoch review queue; passing applicants join the sable tier, escrowing 2.0 units for 12 epochs.
Cost: 100 sybils each escrow 2.0 units for 12 epochs. Flagged clone commit timing burns 90%: they post 200 units, recover about 20, net loss 180 per batch.
